unsupported_claims: For one million nodes the network has tens of millions of edges (the evidence says Erdos-Renyi graphs with average degree 10, so about 5 million edges for 1M nodes, not tens of millions).
The pipeline was run on a single multi-core machine; the evidence does not state the hardware.
rationale: The core claims are supported: node2vec scales linearly, and one million nodes took under four hours, with parallelizable phases. However, the answer adds an unsupported edge count of tens of millions (the evidence implies roughly 5 million) and an unsupported single multi-core machine detail.
